documents.g.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text [{part}]
%rule part letter | pause | mark
%rule letter "a" :: (L ∪ Sound-0061-s) := "a" | "b" :: (L ∪ Sound-0062-s) := "b" | "c" :: (L ∪ Sound-0063-s) := "c" | "d" :: (L ∪ Sound-0064-s) := "d" %emits $

%rule pause " " :: (P ∪ Sound-002E-s) := "." :- " " %emits $

%rule mark "!"
```
